_jobApplication.jobTitle: Director, Applied AI Transformation - Software & Hi-Tech
_jobApplication.jobDescription: EPAM. Director, Applied AI Transformation (Software & Hi-Tech), Europe, hybrid or remote. Lead enterprise-scale AI and agentic transformation for global software and technology organizations, act as trusted advisor to senior executives, and deliver practical AI with measurable business impact. Responsibilities: define and execute applied AI and agentic transformation strategies for software/hi-tech clients; trusted advisor to C-suite on AI adoption and digital innovation; lead presales (shape opportunities, develop business cases, win engagements); facilitate workshops turning business/technology challenges into actionable AI use cases; drive enterprise-wide AI adoption via change management and measurable value; lead cross-functional teams delivering scalable enterprise AI and multi-agent solutions; maintain hands-on knowledge of LLMs, multi-agent orchestration frameworks, and advanced AI platforms; ensure AI solutions comply with security and regulatory standards while scaling; build and mentor EPAM and client teams; monitor trends and promote EPAM as a thought leader. Requirements: 10+ years in software and hi-tech with leadership roles in transformation or product innovation; strong knowledge of software lifecycle, platform engineering, enterprise-grade delivery models; proven success advising executives on AI strategy and leading enterprise-scale adoption; practical expertise with applied AI (LLMs, multi-agent orchestration, RAG); familiarity with OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft AI, and hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud); ability to originate and convert engagements via presales and business-case development; track record building and leading cross-functional global teams; excellent executive communication and stakeholder management; advanced degree in CS/Engineering or Business, MBA preferred; ability to travel. Eligibility: Swiss/EU/EFTA nationals, or third-country nationals based in Switzerland with an appropriate work permit.
_jobApplication.notes: Strong fit on applied AI depth + advisory + thought leadership: owns AI transformation end to end (LumApps, Anand Creations), executive/investor advisory (Tenity 20+, C-level reporting), enterprise AI adoption + change management + business cases (Beekeeper onboarding agent 100%, GenAI demo, $337K, $1.5M referral), hands-on LLM/multi-agent/RAG across OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, GCP, AWS (Microsoft cert for MS AI familiarity), MBA, team leadership/mentoring, security/regulatory (SwissNRI), and a strong speaking/writing thought-leadership record (Front + Developer Week keynotes, published case studies). Zurich-based (third-country national with Swiss work permit). Honest stretch NOT hidden: title is a Director-level consultancy role; candidate's leadership is founder + tech-lead + advisor scale rather than prior Director-at-a-consultancy with formal presales/deal-origination quota and large global team P&L. Azure depth is light (has AWS/GCP + Microsoft cert).
